Mr. A.R. Kapadnis, A.P.P, for Respondent No.1-State.
 .....
 Coram : Prithviraj K. Chavan, J.
Date : 19th June, 2023.

This is an application for suspension of sentence under section 389 of the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1973 for release of the applicant-convict on bail, pending the appeal, who came to be
convicted and sentenced by the Additional Sessions Judge (Pocso Court) Sangli for the offences
punishable under sections 376 (3) and 363 of the Indian Penal Code and under section 5 (1) r/w 6 of
the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
2. Heard learned Counsel for the applicant.
